title: Kitchen science: warm and cold
learner_outcome: With a parent, the child names and sorts warm and cold things, says why the kettle is a grown-up job, and explains one example in their own words.

time_estimate.rationale: Two short parent-led sessions; no attainment claim is made for a 15-minute activity.

objectives.title: Name one warm and one cold thing in the kitchen
evidence_criteria: Names one warm and one cold thing with a parent present
Points at the warm object before naming it
Gives one cold example from the kitchen

objectives.title: Sort picture cards into warm and cold
evidence_criteria: Sorts four cards with no more than one prompt

objectives.title: Say why the kettle is a grown-up job
Explain one example in their own words
evidence_criteria: Produces one sentence about a warm or cold thing

sections.title: Warm things at home
sections.lesson_intent: Parent names warm objects the child can see, one at a time, and the child says each word back.
context_needs: four picture cards: a kettle, a toaster, a fridge and an ice tray (parent-supplied props, not lesson media)

sections.title: Cold things at home
sections.lesson_intent: Parent names cold objects, then sorts four picture cards - a kettle, a toaster, a fridge and an ice tray - into warm and cold together; the cards are parent-supplied props, so the lesson declares no media artifact of its own.
context_needs: four picture cards: a kettle, a toaster, a fridge and an ice tray (parent-supplied props, not lesson media)

sections.title: Why the kettle is a grown-up job
sections.lesson_intent: Parent explains the kettle rule and the child says the safety reason back.

sections.title: Explain one example
sections.lesson_intent: Parent asks the child to explain one warm or cold example in their own words.

context_needs: four picture cards: a kettle, a toaster, a fridge and an ice tray (parent-supplied props, not lesson media)
exclusions: No child chat: the parent leads every step.
No heat, flame or kettle operation by the child; the kettle stays unplugged and out of reach.
No sourced safety claim: the kettle rule is a parent-supplied house rule for this home, not a general fact.
evidence_note: The kettle rule is a house rule the parent supplied for this home. It is recorded as unverified and is not presented as a sourced general safety finding.

supervision_notes: Adult stays within arm's reach for the whole activity
Kettle stays unplugged and out of reach
setting_materials: four picture cards (kettle, toaster, fridge, ice tray)
parent.parent_facing_summary: Two 15-minute kitchen sessions where you name warm and cold things and explain one grown-up job.
